# NSPanel HAUI 0.5.1

Version 0.5.1 fixes Clock panel item-button routing and improves the Fleet event list. It includes the Home Assistant integration, editor and firmware; the display TFT files are unchanged.

## Before updating

No configuration changes are required. No TFT update is needed; the release continues to require display version 0.4.5.

## Added

- **Fleet events** — filter **Latest events** to the last 24 hours. The event controls have improved keyboard accessibility.

## Fixed

- **Clock panel buttons** — each item button now opens its configured item instead of the preceding item. The component IDs for Clock, Weather and Clock Two now match the display layouts. The reporter confirmed the Clock fix on an EU landscape panel; portrait hardware was not directly tested.

## Contributors

Thanks to [@nothigness](https://github.com/nothigness) for reporting and validating [the Clock panel issue](https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui/issues/97).
